what: two magnitudes of one unit as squares of true proportion: each square's area is its value
use_when: two values of the same kind the articles state, where the size difference is the story: a budget then and a budget now, two cities
avoid_when: different units; a ratio above 40 (the small square is a speck: bars); more than two values (bars)
rules: "compare": two values of one unit, both stated in the article, the larger at most 40 times the smaller;
